a8.facade.text: Just like the Tihar nights of my childhood.

a8.banner.text: I wrote 'Happy Tihar' in my best letters!

a8.lights.text: Two thousand bulbs and not one fuse blown!

a8.street_lamps.text: Both lamps at once! Did everyone see that?

a8.bunting.text: Now my stall is part of the festival too!

a8.street.text: Every corner swept. Chiya Tole sparkles.

a8.door.text: Open doors, open hearts. That's Tihar.

a8.food_stall.text: Free sweets?! I'm a child! I count!

a8.arrive.text: Didi, it's so dark! How will anyone find our shop?
With lights, Bhai. Lots and lots of lights.

a8.outro.text: The brightest street in all of Kathmandu tonight.
Customers came from three toles away!
People keep asking if you'll open another shop, Maya.
Another shop? Maybe... by the lake?
Your Hajurba always dreamed of a shop by the water.
